items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The diff matches the reference. The variable was renamed from `db` to `database`, and the nested .get() fallback follows the existing password/passwd chain.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Two small, local edits that follow existing patterns. No new helpers, no dead code and no duplication.

items.name: Robustness
